items.title: Israel heads to polls for pivotal election defined by security and democracy
items.summary: Many fear neither of the leading political blocs will win enough seats for a majority - meaning weeks or months of political wrangling may lie ahead.

items.title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help
items.summary: The chancellor will axe tariffs on some staples as part of plans to give households "breathing space".

items.title: Kane ends England’s 25-year wait to win men’s Ballon d’Or award
items.summary: Harry Kane becomes the first English player to win the prize since Michael Owen in 2001, and Spain midfielder Alexia Putellas wins the Ballon d’Or Feminin for a record-equalling third time.

items.title: Ex-FBI chief James Comey faces federal charges for third time
items.summary: Comey's lawyers say the case stems from alleged disclosure of classified information to the New York Times in 2016.

items.title: Jay-Z to perform at Super Bowl half-time show
items.summary: The rapper has been involved with the show for years but has never before performed at the NFL championship game.

items.title: Storm Boelo leaves thousands without power as Met Office issues new wind warning
items.summary: A yellow warning for strong winds came in effect at 18:00 on Monday across the west coast of England, Wales and Scotland and eastern parts of Northern Ireland.

items.title: Rise in sales of radios and tinned foods, say retailers, after call to stock up
items.summary: Figures obtained by BBC Newsnight show large spikes in sales of torches, radios and power banks.

items.title: Truce begins in wartorn Ukraine city after it was announced by Melania Trump
items.summary: The ceasefire is meant to allow aid deliveries and the evacuation of civilians.
